post.description:
Registers a new user into the system.
Default role is set to 'Viewer'.
Primary plant is set to the first active plant in the database (since plant_id is not null).

get.description:
Returns a lightweight list of all active system users.
Accessible to any authenticated user.

schema.title: Response Lookup Users Api V1 Users Lookup Get

get.description:
Returns a list of all system users.
Accessible only to system Administrators.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users  Get

put.description:
Updates the technical role of a user.
Options: Admin, PFMEA Owner, Team Member, Viewer.

Toggles the active status of a user.
If inactivated (is_active=False), prepends "ARCHIVED " to their full_name in the DB
to track history under TISAX regulations.
If reactivated, removes the "ARCHIVED " prefix.

post.description:
Resends the verification email with a new 24-hour token.
Only for unverified users.

schema.title: Response Resend Verification Admin Api V1 Users  User Id  Resend Verification Post

post.description: Crea un nuevo diagrama de flujo asociado a un producto. Opcionalmente puede incluir una lista de pasos en la misma solicitud.

schema.title: Response List Flowcharts Api V1 Flowcharts  Get
Response List Products Api V1 Flowcharts Products Get

get.summary: Obtener diagrama de flujo con pasos
get.description: Devuelve el diagrama de flujo completo con sus pasos cargados de forma eager (joinedload) para evitar N+1.

put.summary: Actualizar cabecera del diagrama de flujo
put.description: Actualiza el título, estado y las propiedades del producto asociado a la cabecera.

post.description: Inserta un nuevo paso de proceso en el diagrama de flujo indicado. Valida que el step_number sea único dentro del mismo flowchart.

put.description: Reemplaza atómicamente todos los pasos del diagrama de flujo con el nuevo array ordenado. Usado por el auto-save del frontend después de eventos de Drag & Drop.

patch.description: Archiva un diagrama de flujo: actualiza el estado a 'Archived', crea un registro en document_versions con snapshot completo, inserta en document_audit_logs y notifica al equipo vía email. Solo accesible para roles Administrator y PFMEA Owner.

get.description: Devuelve el historial completo de versiones (DocumentVersion) y registros de auditoría (AuditLog) para un diagrama de flujo específico. Solo accesible para roles Administrator y PFMEA Owner.

get.summary: List versions for a specific document

schema.title: Response List Document Versions Api V1 Document Versions  Document Type   Document Id  Get

get.summary: Get a specific document version by ID

post.description: Creates a new PFMEA analysis linked to an existing flowchart. Generates a hierarchical ID automatically. The creator is added as PFMEA Owner in the core team.

get.description: Paginated list of all PFMEA analyses with optional filters.

schema.title: Response List Analyses Api V1 Pfmea Project  Get

get.description: Returns all worksheet rows assigned to the current user with action_status != 'Completed'. Ordered by priority (H first) and target date.

schema.title: Response Get My Tasks Api V1 Pfmea Project My Tasks Get

get.description: Utility endpoint to calculate the Action Priority (H/M/L) for given Severity, Occurrence, and Detection values per AIAG-VDA 2019 methodology.
Returns the full PFMEA analysis with team members and worksheet rows.

put.description: Update Step 1 metadata (project name, customer, etc.). Blocked if status is Approved or Archived (HTTP 403).

patch.description:
Changes the PFMEA lifecycle status. Gate rules:
- Draft → In Review: all rows must have Steps 3-5 complete.
- In Review → Approved: BLOCKS if any row has AP=H unresolved.
- Approved → Archived: terminal transition.

post.description: Restore an Approved or Archived PFMEA back to Draft, incrementing the version.
Populates/updates worksheet rows from the linked flowchart steps. Creates one row per step that doesn't already have a mapping. Existing rows are updated with fresh structure-analysis data.

schema.title: Response Sync Flowchart Api V1 Pfmea Project  Pfmea Id  Sync Flowchart Post

get.description: Returns all worksheet rows for the specified PFMEA, ordered by sequence.

schema.title: Response Get Worksheet Api V1 Pfmea Project  Pfmea Id  Worksheet Get

post.description: Manually add a new row to the worksheet. AP is auto-calculated if S, O, D are provided.

patch.description: Partial update on a single worksheet row. AP is reactively recalculated if S, O, or D change. Blocked if PFMEA status is Approved or Archived (HTTP 403).

put.description: Bulk update or create multiple worksheet rows. AP is reactively recalculated if S, O, or D change. Blocked if PFMEA status is Approved or Archived (HTTP 403).

schema.title: Response Update Worksheet Bulk Api V1 Pfmea Project  Pfmea Id  Worksheet Bulk Put

get.description: Returns the immutable audit trail for a specific PFMEA analysis.

post.description: Crear/generar encabezado de Plan de Control desde un PFMEA.
Sincronización bajo demanda de causas críticas (AP='H' o S>=9) como ítems de CP.
